name: Message Logger
description: Deleted messages stay in the chat, marked as deleted, and edited messages show what they said before. Kept in memory only: nothing is saved, and it's all gone when Discord restarts.

notes: Says what it needs (reading messages), and Evi holds it to that.
Faster to start: it finds what it needs in Discord without searching all of its code each time.
Right-click a channel, thread, DM or server to clear just its logged messages, without opening settings.
